label: Accept the gaps
description: Always entered, and resolves quietly when every claim was verified (feature.md §6). The multi-select over unverified claims is the §0.7 contract amendment; until it lands the claims to send back are named in the comments.

binding.text:
These claims have no passing acceptance test. Everything else was verified.

approve — ship with these gaps, accepted and recorded.
revise — back to writing tests for the ones you name.

Name in the comments which gaps you accept and which you are sending back: the multi-select this gate wants is a pending contract amendment (feature.md §0.7).

inputs.reasons.description: Shown instead of the bare number: 0.62 tells a person nothing.

inputs.must_ask.description: Non-empty means ask regardless of score.

outputs.accepted.description: Which unverified claims are accepted as gaps. Arrives only once the select_many component of §0.7 lands; until then the comments carry it.
